translations.coverTagline: Markdown slides with native translations and file includes. One binary, no build step.
translations.navHint: → / ← or swipe to move between slides
translations.markdownText: No Vue, no React, no config: a .md file is a talk.
translations.includesText: One !include(slides) pulls a whole directory, in order. This talk is built that way.
translations.languagesText: Slides hold $$key$$ variables, the words live in en.lang.json, fr.lang.json…
translations.layoutsLeft: Templates are plain HTML with named blocks. Themes, components and plugins are shared on the hub.
translations.speakerTimers: A timer per slide and checkpoints
translations.speakerPhone: Drive the talk from your phone with a QR code
translations.openSpeakerView: Open the speaker view of this demo ↗
translations.shareText: PDF, PowerPoint, a static site for GitHub or GitLab Pages, or hosted on slidesk.link.
translations.importText: PowerPoint, Google Slides, Slidev and reveal.js decks become SliDesk talks.
translations.telnetText: Yes, really: --telnet serves a text version of your talk.
